items.t: Oracle Has Frustrated Me, but Even With Zero AI Revenue the Stock Is Worth $133—So I’m Buying at $104
items.sum: Oracle has piled on debt, diluted shareholders, and burned cash, yet one analyst's brutal stress test suggests the old business alone may protect new buyers. What happens when every AI contract is assumed to fail?

items.t: Near-Equal ~$664B–$678B Backlogs: Why Oracle’s AI Concentration Risk Differs From Microsoft’s
